Static review complete. Verdicts below are source-traced (no execution — the three assigned executor fact-count commands belong to Count* seats; my lane is read-only).

## Findings

**Canonical membership check — sound.** `tools/command-binding.py:93` (`evaluate()`) uses `set(receipts) != set(requirements)` after building both maps under per-name uniqueness prechecks (lines 79–80 `DUPLICATE_REQUIREMENT` exit 2; lines 89–90 `DUPLICATE_COMMAND` exit 1). No `len()`-based membership anywhere in the file (grep-confirmed: `len(receipts)`/`len(requirements)` count = 0). The missing-vs-positive-count attack is correctly discriminated: `receipts.pop()` shrinks the name set → `MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH`, never a count verdict. Frozen `contract.json` (schema `command-binding-round23-v1`, ten items) maps 1:1 onto implemented predicates; `requirements.json` verified = the 43 `active` baseline rows of `registry-baseline.json`, unique names, argv/expect par…

**Coverage gaps in the frozen ten — the count/positive-count weakness is unprobed in four ways:**
1. `missing-required-command` only ever `pop()`s the **tail**. A head-only, prefix-only, or last-receipt-only gate discriminates 10/10. A `pop(0)` probe is absent.
2. **No pure-superset probe.** `unknown-command` conflates missing+extra in one mutation, so a containment-only gate (`set(requirements) ⊆ set(receipts)` — the literal "positive coverage" reading) is never rejected.
3. **Same-count masking is only probed by rename, never by a retained duplicate.** A count-equality-plus-per-receipt-validity gate (`len ==` + valid rows, no name-set comparison) discriminates all ten yet passes a bundle where a second `one` receipt masks absent `two`.
4. **No zero-receipts floor** (`receipts=[]` never tested) and **no clean-reorder positive control** (`[two, one]` never tested), so neither the positive-count floor nor the set-vs-list-equality semantics are pinned.

**Minor contract ambiguities (not defects):**
- No finding-precedence rule when predicates overlap. With a duplicate receipt masking a missing requirement, canonical emits `DUPLICATE_COMMAND` (early return, line 90) before `MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH` can accrue. Any same-count-missing fixture that uses a duplicate name MUST pin this precedence or risk mis-scoring the canonical gate.
- `MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH` is also emitted by `tools/wave-accounting.py:109` for wave-seat bookkeeping. Per-tool scoped IDs are consistent, but any cross-tool finding aggregation conflates two populations. Informational only.

## Proposed set-equality fixtures (deltas against `measure.py fixture()`, ruler style)

| # | Case | Mutation | Expected | Kills |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | `masked-missing-duplicate` | `bundle['receipts'][1] = copy.deepcopy(bundle['receipts'][0])` | 1 / `DUPLICATE_COMMAND` (pin precedence; `MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH` acceptable iff contract declares name-set evaluation precedes duplicate detection) | count-equality gates, `commands_executed_count`-style positive-count binding |
| F2 | `extra-receipt-superset` | append `{'name':'other','argv':['python3','gate.py','--other'],'cwd':'/fixture/repo','revision':'a'*40,'exit':0,'stdout':'OTHER\n','stderr':''}` | 1 / `MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH` | containment-only (⊆) gates |
| F3 | `missing-first-receipt` | `bundle['receipts'].pop(0)` | 1 / `MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH` | head/tail-only membership scans |
| F4 | `zero-receipts` | `bundle['receipts'].clear()` | 1 / `MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH` | vacuous-pass loops; pins "no receipts" as binding failure, not evaluation error |
| F5 | `reordered-receipts` (positive control) | `bundle['receipts'].reverse()` | 0 / `[]` | positional `zip` pairing and list-equality gates; pins set semantics |

All five verified against the canonical `evaluate()` by static trace: F1→`DUPLICATE_COMMAND`@90, F2/F3/F4→`MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH`@94, F5→clean exit 0. Fixture JSON encoding: `encode()` (indent=2, sort_keys, trailing `\n`); expected file pins `bundle_sha256` over those exact bytes — same pinning convention as existing cases.

## Residual risk / verification gaps

- No runtime verification performed (read-only lane, no execution authorization); all expected outcomes are static traces of `command-binding.py@FAC4` — corroborating peer execution or the executor lanes' counts would confirm.
- Frozen ruler cannot be amended this wave; fixtures target a future `command-binding-round23-v2` schema revision.
- Field-level attacks (argv/cwd/revision/exit/stdout) remain probed only on `receipts[0]`/`name 'one'` — second-row field probes are outside my missing-vs-count scope but noted for Overlap.
- No installs performed (none needed; pacman paused per rules).

Report write skipped per wave-wide no-write directive; findings delivered here for L1 persistence (`.ufo/waves/round-23/w1/MissingAttack.md` path noted but not written).
